text:
Dorian Feltz has been appointed chief executive of Varnholt Logistics, the company announced on 12 March. He takes up the post on 1 April.

The decision was made at an extraordinary board meeting held on 11 March, according to the company's formal press release, which this paper has seen.

Margit Osterlund, chair of the Varnholt Logistics board, confirmed the appointment when contacted. She said Feltz was chosen after a seven-month search.

Feltz will oversee a workforce of 4,300 employees across 11 distribution hubs, the press release states.

The appointment ends a lengthy period of uncertainty at the top of one of the area's larger employers. Staff will be watching closely to see what priorities the new chief executive sets once he arrives next month.

The Gazette will report further as details emerge.
